assumptions: Stop is interpreted as remaining still (speed <=0.05) continuously for at least 1000 ms; the statute states 'shall stop' with no minimum duration.
Zone 'inspection' is taken to be the place described as near-side stop-line approach lanes.
Line 'packing_entry' is taken to be the clearly marked stop line.
Crossing direction 'to_left' is assumed from line metadata that cars travel from bottom-right to top-left; the statute states no direction.
Anchor 'bottom_center' is chosen as the vehicle ground-contact point; the statute states no measurement point.
'Unless otherwise directed by a police officer or traffic control signal' is behaviour the camera cannot see and is excluded from the check.
Objects that never cross the stop line vacuously pass; only vehicles that cross are required to have stopped beforehand.
No maximum time gap is enforced between the stop and the crossing.
raw_output.normalized_explanation: Every vehicle that crosses the packing_entry stop line must first remain stopped in the inspection zone for at least 1000 ms.

at a clearly marked stop line

provenance.reason: Statute states 'shall stop' with no duration; 1000 ms chosen as minimum continuous still time to count as a stop.
Line metadata says cars travel from bottom-right to top-left and moving leftwards/upwards across it = to_left; statute gives no direction.
Zones and lines drawn for ground contact in top-down view; bottom_center is where vehicle touches ground; statute gives no measurement point.

text: Unless otherwise directed by a police officer or traffic control signal, the driver of a vehicle approaching a stop sign at an intersection shall stop at the near side of the intersection at a clearly marked stop line.
